name: Bobbatlu (Puran Poli)
instructions: 1. Soak chana dal for 1 hour, then cook until soft and drain excess water. 2. Mash the dal and mix with grated jaggery in a pan, heating until it thickens into a pliable paste (puran). 3. Add cardamom and nutmeg powder, then let the mixture cool. 4. Knead maida, wheat flour, turmeric, oil, and water into a very soft, elastic dough and let it rest for 2 hours. 5. Take a small portion of dough, flatten it, place a ball of the puran mixture in the center, and seal it completely. 6. Carefully roll the stuffed ball into a thin, round disc using oil. 7. Roast on a hot griddle with a generous amount of ghee until golden brown spots appear on both sides.
description: Bobbatlu is a traditional sweet delicacy prepared during festive occasions like Ugadi and Sankranti. It represents prosperity and is considered an auspicious offering to deities and guests alike.
